source.text: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] word of Yahweh to me, saying:

en.L: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me, saying:
en.B: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me:
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave me this message:

fr.L: Et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée, disant :
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée :
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné ce message :

es.L: Vino a mí la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, diciendo:
es.B: La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a mí:
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio este mensaje:

decisions.choice: the formula as in Jeremiah
decisions.reason: "The word of the LORD came to me, saying" keeps the wording set for Jeremiah at each level, here and at verses 17 and 23. The chapter has three messages against Jerusalem: its crimes (verses 1-16), the furnace (17-22), and the failure of every group of its leaders and people (23-31).

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֔ם הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֥ט הֲתִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת־עִ֣יר הַדָּמִ֑ים וְה֣וֹדַעְתָּ֔הּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then make known to her all her abominations.

en.L: And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then make known to her all her abominations.
en.B: As for you, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices.
en.R: Son of man, are you ready to judge? Will you judge this city that is guilty of murder? Then show her all the disgusting things she has done.

fr.L: Et toi, fils d’homme, jugeras-tu, jugeras-tu la ville de sang ? Alors fais-lui connaître toutes ses abominations.
fr.B: Quant à toi, fils d’homme, veux-tu juger ? Veux-tu juger la ville sanguinaire ? Alors mets-la en face de toutes ses pratiques détestables.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, es-tu prêt à juger ? Veux-tu juger cette ville coupable de meurtres ? Alors montre-lui toutes les choses dégoûtantes qu’elle a faites.

es.L: Y tú, hijo de hombre, ¿juzgarás, juzgarás a la ciudad sanguinaria? Hazle conocer, pues, todas sus abominaciones.
es.B: En cuanto a ti, hijo de hombre, ¿vas a juzgar? ¿Vas a juzgar a la ciudad sanguinaria? Entonces ponla frente a todas sus prácticas detestables.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, ¿estás dispuesto a juzgar? ¿Vas a juzgar a esta ciudad culpable de asesinatos? Entonces muéstrale todas las cosas repugnantes que ha hecho.

decisions.choice: will you judge?: a call to bring the charge, in effect a command
decisions.reason: As in 20:4, the repeated question tells the prophet to state the case against the city, and the command that follows says how.

decisions.choice: the city of bloodshed: a city guilty of shedding blood
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "the city of bloods", a plural that means bloodshed and the guilt it brings. Nahum 3:1 calls Nineveh the same, and Ezekiel uses it again of Jerusalem in 24:6 and 9. The blood is murder and violence, including the deaths caused by injustice and child sacrifice (verses 6-12; 16:20-21).

decisions.choice: this city that is guilty of murder
decisions.reason: Readable says what the name means (m2). Jerusalem is "her", as the city is pictured as a woman throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: "la ville de sang" (L); "la ville sanguinaire" (B); "cette ville coupable de meurtres" (R); the city is "elle", and "tu" with feminine agreement when addressed
decisions.reason: Jerusalem is addressed as a woman, as the term sheet sets for personified cities; French shows it in its agreements ("tu es devenue coupable").

decisions.choice: la ciudad sanguinaria
alternatives: la ciudad de los derramamientos de sangre
decisions.reason: 'Sanguinaria' says in one natural Spanish word what 'city of bloods' means, a city guilty of shedding blood.

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה עִ֣יר שֹׁפֶ֥כֶת דָּ֛ם בְּתוֹכָ֖הּ לָב֣וֹא עִתָּ֑הּ וְעָשְׂתָ֧ה גִלּוּלִ֛ים עָלֶ֖יהָ לְטָמְאָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And say, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: A city shedding blood in her midst, for coming of her time, and [that] makes idols for herself, for defiling!

en.L: And say, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: A city shedding blood in her midst, so that her time comes, and that makes filthy idols for herself, to defile herself!
en.B: Say, The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: A city that sheds blood within her walls and so brings on her time of doom, that makes idols for herself and so defiles herself!
en.R: Say, This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: This city kills people inside its walls, and so it brings its own time of judgment closer. It makes idols for itself, and they make it unclean.

fr.L: Et dis : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Ville qui répand le sang au milieu d’elle, pour que vienne son temps, et qui se fait des idoles immondes pour se souiller !
fr.B: Dis : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Ville qui répand le sang dans ses murs et précipite ainsi l’heure de sa ruine, qui se fait des idoles et se rend ainsi impure !
fr.R: Dis : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Cette ville tue des gens à l’intérieur de ses murs, et elle rapproche ainsi le moment de son jugement. Elle se fabrique des idoles, et ces idoles la rendent impure.

es.L: Y di: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: ¡Ciudad que derrama sangre en medio de sí, para que llegue su hora, y que se hace ídolos inmundos, para contaminarse!
es.B: Di: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: ¡Ciudad que derramas sangre dentro de tus muros y así apresuras la hora de tu condena, que te haces ídolos y así te contaminas!
es.R: Di: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Esta ciudad mata a la gente dentro de sus muros, y así hace que se acerque la hora de su castigo. Se hace ídolos, y los ídolos la hacen impura.

decisions.choice: her time: the time of her judgment
decisions.reason: "Time" here is the appointed time of punishment, as in 7:7, 12 and 21:30. By her own acts the city brings it nearer.

decisions.choice: bloodshed and idols: the two charges of the chapter
decisions.reason: Ezekiel brings the two together again and again: wrongs against people (blood) and wrongs against God (idols). Both make the city unclean, and both bring judgment (verse 4; 36:18).

decisions.choice: kills people
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what shedding blood means, and calls the city "it", which is clearer in plain English. Verse 4 then speaks to the city as "you", as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: the city addressed with 'tú' (derramas, te haces), feminine
decisions.reason: From verse 4 the Hebrew speaks to the city as 'you' (feminine singular); B makes the address begin here, so that the oracle reads as one speech to Jerusalem.

source.text: בְּדָמֵ֨ךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁפַ֜כְתְּ אָשַׁ֗מְתְּ וּבְגִלּוּלַ֤יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂית֙ טָמֵ֔את וַתַּקְרִ֣יבִי יָמַ֔יִךְ וַתָּב֖וֹא עַד־שְׁנוֹתָ֑יִךְ עַל־כֵּ֗ן נְתַתִּ֤יךְ חֶרְפָּה֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקַלָּסָ֖ה לְכָל־הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: By your blood that you have shed you have become guilty, and by your idols that you have made you have become defiled, and you have brought near your days and come to your years. Therefore I have made you a disgrace among the nations and an object of mockery to all the lands.

en.L: By your blood that you have shed you have become guilty, and by your filthy idols that you have made you have become defiled; and you have brought near your days, and you have come to your years. Therefore I have made you a disgrace among the nations and an object of mockery to all the lands.
en.B: You have become guilty by the blood you have shed, and made unclean by the idols you have made. You have hastened your days and come to the end of your years. So I have made you an object of scorn to the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.
en.R: You are guilty because you have murdered people. You are unclean because you have made idols. You have brought your end closer, and the end of your life has come. So I have made you something the nations scorn. All the countries make fun of you.

fr.L: Par ton sang que tu as répandu tu es devenue coupable, et par tes idoles immondes que tu as faites tu t’es souillée ; et tu as fait approcher tes jours, et tu es arrivée à tes années. C’est pourquoi je fais de toi un objet d’opprobre pour les nations et un objet de moquerie pour tous les pays.
fr.B: Tu t’es rendue coupable par le sang que tu as répandu, et impure par les idoles que tu as faites. Tu as hâté tes jours et tu es arrivée au terme de tes années. C’est pourquoi je fais de toi un objet de mépris pour les nations et la risée de tous les pays.
fr.R: Tu es coupable parce que tu as tué des gens. Tu es impure parce que tu as fabriqué des idoles. Tu as rapproché ta fin, et la fin de ta vie est arrivée. C’est pourquoi je fais de toi un objet de mépris pour les nations. Tous les pays se moquent de toi.

es.L: Por tu sangre que has derramado te has hecho culpable, y por tus ídolos inmundos que has hecho te has contaminado; y has hecho acercar tus días, y has llegado a tus años. Por tanto, te he hecho afrenta para las naciones y burla para todas las tierras.
es.B: Te has hecho culpable por la sangre que has derramado, y te has contaminado con los ídolos que has hecho. Has apresurado tus días y has llegado al fin de tus años. Por eso te he convertido en objeto de desprecio para las naciones y en motivo de burla para todos los países.
es.R: Eres culpable porque has asesinado a gente. Eres impura porque has hecho ídolos. Has hecho que se acerque tu fin, y ha llegado el final de tu vida. Por eso te he convertido en algo que las naciones desprecian. Todos los países se burlan de ti.

decisions.choice: brought near your days, come to your years: brought on the end of your life
decisions.reason: The days and years are the city's lifetime, which is now running out. Her crimes have hastened the day of judgment (verse 3).

decisions.choice: a reproach to the nations and a mockery: a ruin that others scorn
decisions.reason: This is the curse that the law warns of (Deuteronomy 28:37) and that 5:14-15 already threatened against Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: brought your end closer; the end of your life has come
alternatives: brought near your days; come to your years
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: Jerusalem addressed as 'tú' with feminine agreement (impura, llena)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'you' of verses 4-16 is feminine singular, the city as a woman, so Spanish uses 'tú' with feminine adjectives.

source.text: הַקְּרֹב֛וֹת וְהָרְחֹק֥וֹת מִמֵּ֖ךְ יִתְקַלְּסוּ־בָ֑ךְ טְמֵאַ֣ת הַשֵּׁ֔ם רַבַּ֖ת הַמְּהוּמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Those near and those far from you will mock you, defiled of name, full of turmoil.

en.L: Those near and those far from you will mock you, [you] defiled of name, full of turmoil.
en.B: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, you city with a stained name, full of turmoil.
en.R: People who live near you and people far away will make fun of you. Your name is ruined, and you are full of disorder.

fr.L: Ceux qui sont proches et ceux qui sont loin de toi se moqueront de toi, [toi] souillée de nom, pleine de tumulte.
fr.B: Ceux qui sont près et ceux qui sont loin se moqueront de toi, ville au nom souillé, pleine de désordre.
fr.R: Les gens qui vivent près de toi et ceux qui vivent loin se moqueront de toi. Ta réputation est ruinée, et tu es pleine de désordre.

es.L: Los cercanos y los lejanos de ti se burlarán de ti, manchada de nombre, llena de alboroto.
es.B: Los que están cerca y los que están lejos se burlarán de ti, ciudad de nombre manchado, llena de alboroto.
es.R: La gente que vive cerca de ti y la que vive lejos se burlará de ti. Tu nombre está arruinado, y estás llena de desorden.

decisions.choice: defiled of name: a city whose reputation is stained
decisions.reason: The name is the city's reputation. Jerusalem, which bore God's name (1 Kings 11:36), is now known for its uncleanness.

decisions.choice: full of turmoil: full of disorder and panic
decisions.reason: The word is used of confusion and unrest in a society (Amos 3:9) and of the panic God sends on his enemies (Deuteronomy 7:23). Both senses fit a city torn by violence.

source.text: הִנֵּה֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֥ישׁ לִזְרֹע֖וֹ הָ֣יוּ בָ֑ךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁפָךְ־דָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Behold, [the] princes of Israel, each according to his arm, have been in you, in order to shed blood.

en.L: See, the princes of Israel, each according to his arm, have been in you to shed blood.
en.B: Look at the princes of Israel within you: each of them uses his power to shed blood.
en.R: Look at the rulers of Israel who live in you. Each of them uses his power to kill people.

fr.L: Voici, les princes d’Israël, chacun selon son bras, ont été chez toi pour répandre le sang.
fr.B: Regarde les princes d’Israël qui sont chez toi : chacun d’eux se sert de son pouvoir pour répandre le sang.
fr.R: Regarde les chefs d’Israël qui vivent chez toi. Chacun d’eux se sert de son pouvoir pour tuer des gens.

es.L: Mira, los príncipes de Israel, cada uno según su brazo, han estado en ti para derramar sangre.
es.B: Mira a los príncipes de Israel que hay en ti: cada uno usa su poder para derramar sangre.
es.R: Mira a los gobernantes de Israel que viven en ti. Cada uno usa su poder para matar gente.

decisions.choice: each according to his arm: each by the power he had
decisions.reason: The arm stands for strength. Each ruler used his power for violence instead of justice.

decisions.choice: the princes of Israel: the kings of Judah and their royal house
decisions.reason: Ezekiel uses "prince" for Israel's kings (12:10; 21:30). The books of Kings and Jeremiah charge kings of Judah with shedding innocent blood: Manasseh filled Jerusalem with it (2 Kings 21:16; 24:4), and Jehoiakim's eyes and heart were set on shedding it (Jeremiah 22:17).

decisions.choice: rulers
decisions.reason: The word for prince is "prince" at Literal and Balanced and "ruler" at Readable, as set for Ezekiel.

source.text: אָ֤ב וָאֵם֙ הֵקַ֣לּוּ בָ֔ךְ לַגֵּ֛ר עָשׂ֥וּ בַעֹ֖שֶׁק בְּתוֹכֵ֑ךְ יָת֥וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֖ה ה֥וֹנוּ בָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Father and mother they have treated with contempt in you; toward the sojourner they have acted with oppression in your midst; orphan and widow they have wronged in you.

en.L: Father and mother they have treated with contempt in you; with the sojourner they have dealt by oppression in your midst; the fatherless and the widow they have wronged in you.
en.B: In you, father and mother are treated with contempt; in your midst the foreigner is oppressed; in you the orphan and the widow are wronged.
en.R: People in you do not respect their fathers and mothers. They oppress foreigners who live among them. They mistreat orphans and widows.

fr.L: Le père et la mère, on les a méprisés chez toi ; envers l’étranger on a agi avec oppression au milieu de toi ; l’orphelin et la veuve, on les a maltraités chez toi.
fr.B: Chez toi, on méprise le père et la mère ; au milieu de toi, on opprime l’étranger ; chez toi, on maltraite l’orphelin et la veuve.
fr.R: Chez toi, les gens ne respectent pas leur père et leur mère. Ils oppriment les étrangers qui vivent parmi eux. Ils maltraitent les orphelins et les veuves.

es.L: Al padre y a la madre han despreciado en ti; al forastero han tratado con opresión en medio de ti; al huérfano y a la viuda han maltratado en ti.
es.B: En ti se desprecia al padre y a la madre; en medio de ti se oprime al extranjero; en ti se maltrata al huérfano y a la viuda.
es.R: La gente que vive en ti no respeta a su padre ni a su madre. Oprime a los extranjeros que viven entre ellos. Maltrata a los huérfanos y a las viudas.

decisions.choice: the commands of the law, broken one by one
decisions.reason: The list in verses 7-12 follows the laws of Leviticus 18-20 and Exodus 20-23: honor father and mother (Exodus 20:12; Leviticus 19:3), do not wrong the foreigner (Exodus 22:20; Leviticus 19:33-34), do not mistreat the widow or the fatherless (Exodus 22:21-23). Deuteronomy 27:16-19 puts curses on the same acts.

decisions.choice: the sojourner: a foreigner living in Israel without land or family there
decisions.reason: Such people, like orphans and widows, had no one to protect them, and the law put them under God's special care.

decisions.choice: sojourner (L); foreigner (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording follows Exodus 22:20, as published. Balanced puts the three clauses in the passive, which keeps the Hebrew's stress on the victims.

decisions.choice: forastero (L); extranjero (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ger is a foreigner living in Israel without land or family; L keeps the older word for a resident stranger, B and R use the plain word, as Spanish Jeremiah 7:6.

source.text: קָדָשַׁ֖י בָּזִ֑ית וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י חִלָּֽלְתְּ׃

records.literal_gloss: My holy things you have despised, and my sabbaths you have profaned.

en.L: My holy things you have despised, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths you have profaned.
en.B: You have despised {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy things and dishonored {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths.
en.R: You have treated {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy things with scorn. You have treated {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbath days with no respect.

fr.L: Mes choses saintes, tu les as méprisées, et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats, tu les as profanés.
fr.B: Tu as méprisé {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} choses saintes et déshonoré {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats.
fr.R: Tu as traité {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} choses saintes avec mépris. Tu n’as eu aucun respect pour {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jours de sabbat.

es.L: Mis cosas santas has despreciado, y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados has profanado.
es.B: Has despreciado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} cosas santas y has deshonrado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados.
es.R: Has tratado con desprecio {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} cosas santas. No has respetado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados.

decisions.choice: my holy things: everything set apart for God: offerings, the sanctuary and what belongs to it
decisions.reason: Leviticus 19:8 and 22:2 warn against profaning the LORD's holy things. Verse 26 charges the priests with the same sin.

decisions.choice: profaning the Sabbaths: as in 20:13
decisions.reason: The Sabbath was the sign of the covenant (20:12), and profaning it is named again here and in verse 26.

source.text: אַנְשֵׁ֥י רָכִ֛יל הָ֥יוּ בָ֖ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־דָּ֑ם וְאֶל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ אָ֣כְלוּ בָ֔ךְ זִמָּ֖ה עָשׂ֥וּ בְתוֹכֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Men of slander have been in you in order to shed blood; and on the mountains they have eaten in you; lewdness they have done in your midst.

en.L: Men of slander have been in you, in order to shed blood; and on the mountains they have eaten in you; lewdness they have committed in your midst.
en.B: In you are slanderers who are out to shed blood. In you are those who eat at the mountain shrines. In your midst they commit depraved acts.
en.R: Some of your people tell lies about others so that they will be put to death. Some eat sacrifices to idols at the shrines on the mountains. Others do shameful things.

fr.L: Des hommes de calomnie ont été chez toi pour répandre le sang ; et sur les montagnes on a mangé chez toi ; on a commis l’infamie au milieu de toi.
fr.B: Chez toi, il y a des calomniateurs qui cherchent à répandre le sang. Chez toi, il y a des gens qui mangent dans les sanctuaires des montagnes. Au milieu de toi, on commet des actes infâmes.
fr.R: Certains de tes habitants racontent des mensonges sur d’autres pour les faire mettre à mort. Certains mangent des sacrifices offerts aux idoles dans les sanctuaires des montagnes. D’autres font des choses honteuses.

es.L: Hombres calumniadores ha habido en ti para derramar sangre; y sobre los montes han comido en ti; infamia han cometido en medio de ti.
es.B: En ti hay calumniadores que buscan derramar sangre. En ti hay quienes comen en los santuarios de los montes. En medio de ti se cometen actos depravados.
es.R: Algunos de los tuyos dicen mentiras sobre otros para que los condenen a muerte. Algunos comen sacrificios ofrecidos a los ídolos en los santuarios de los montes. Otros hacen cosas vergonzosas.

decisions.choice: slanderers who shed blood: false accusers who bring about the death of others
decisions.reason: Leviticus 19:16 puts the two together: "Do not go about as a slanderer among your people; do not stand against the blood of your neighbor." The false witnesses against Naboth are an example (1 Kings 21:10-13).

decisions.choice: eating on the mountains: sacrificial meals at the hill shrines
decisions.reason: To "eat on the mountains" is to share in the feasts held at idol shrines on the hills (18:6, 11, 15).

decisions.choice: lewdness: shameful, depraved acts, especially sexual sins
decisions.reason: The word is used for sexual wrongs in Leviticus 18:17 and 20:14, and it leads into the list of verses 10-11.

decisions.choice: slanderers (B); people who tell lies about others (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "men of"; Balanced and Readable use words that name the act, which applies to anyone who does it. Readable adds "sacrifices to idols" to say what the eating means (m2).

source.text: עֶרְוַת־אָ֖ב גִּלָּה־בָ֑ךְ טְמֵאַ֥ת הַנִּדָּ֖ה עִנּוּ־בָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] nakedness of a father they uncover in you; [a woman] unclean in impurity they violate in you.

en.L: In you they uncover [their] father's nakedness; in you they violate [a woman who is] unclean in [her] impurity.
en.B: In you men have sexual relations with their father's wife; in you they violate women who are unclean during their monthly period.
en.R: In you men have sexual relations with their fathers' wives. They violate women during their monthly periods, when the women are unclean.

fr.L: Chez toi, on découvre la nudité [de leur] père ; chez toi, on fait violence à [la femme] impure dans [son] impureté.
fr.B: Chez toi, des hommes ont des relations avec la femme de leur père ; chez toi, on fait violence à des femmes impures pendant leurs règles.
fr.R: Chez toi, des hommes ont des relations sexuelles avec la femme de leur père. Ils font violence à des femmes pendant leurs règles, quand elles sont impures.

es.L: En ti descubren la desnudez del padre; en ti violan a [la mujer] impura en su menstruación.
es.B: En ti hay hombres que tienen relaciones sexuales con la mujer de su padre; en ti violan a mujeres que están impuras durante su menstruación.
es.R: En ti hay hombres que tienen relaciones sexuales con la mujer de su padre. Violan a mujeres durante su período mensual, cuando están impuras.

decisions.choice: uncover a father's nakedness: have sexual relations with one's father's wife
decisions.reason: This is the language of the law. Leviticus 18:7-8 and 20:11 forbid a man to have relations with his father's wife, "the nakedness of your father".

decisions.choice: a woman unclean in her impurity: a woman during her monthly period
decisions.reason: Leviticus 18:19 and 20:18 forbid sexual relations during a woman's monthly period, while she is ritually unclean.

decisions.choice: violate: humiliate sexually, often by force
decisions.reason: The verb means to humble or humiliate. It is used for rape (Genesis 34:2; 2 Samuel 13:12-14) and for relations that shame a woman (Deuteronomy 22:24, 29). Here it stresses the wrong done to the woman.

decisions.choice: plain and sober wording: "have sexual relations with their father's wife"; "violate"
decisions.reason: As the book's register rule says for these passages, Literal follows the Hebrew and Balanced and Readable state the meaning plainly, neither blurring it nor adding detail. The wording follows Leviticus 18:8 and 18:19, as published.

decisions.choice: plain and sober wording: 'tienen relaciones sexuales con la mujer de su padre'; 'violan'
decisions.reason: B and R say what the Hebrew idiom means, plainly and without making it cruder; L keeps the idiom of Leviticus 18.

source.text: וְאִ֣ישׁ׀אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֗הוּ עָשָׂה֙ תּֽוֹעֵבָ֔ה וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־כַּלָּת֖וֹ טִמֵּ֣א בְזִמָּ֑ה וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־אֲחֹת֥וֹ בַת־אָבִ֖יו עִנָּה־בָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And a man with [the] wife of his neighbor commits abomination, and a man his daughter-in-law defiles with lewdness, and a man his sister, [the] daughter of his father, violates in you.

en.L: And a man commits an abomination with his neighbor's wife, and a man defiles his daughter-in-law with lewdness, and a man in you violates his sister, his father's daughter.
en.B: One man commits a detestable act with his neighbor's wife; another shamefully defiles his daughter-in-law; and another in you violates his sister, his own father's daughter.
en.R: One man does a disgusting thing with his neighbor's wife. Another has sexual relations with his daughter-in-law and so makes her unclean. Another violates his own sister, his father's daughter.

fr.L: Et l’un commet une abomination avec la femme de son prochain, et l’autre souille sa belle-fille par l’infamie, et l’autre chez toi fait violence à sa sœur, la fille de son père.
fr.B: L’un commet une pratique détestable avec la femme de son prochain ; un autre souille honteusement sa belle-fille ; un autre encore, chez toi, fait violence à sa sœur, la propre fille de son père.
fr.R: L’un fait une chose dégoûtante avec la femme de son voisin. Un autre a des relations sexuelles avec sa belle-fille et la rend ainsi impure. Un autre fait violence à sa propre sœur, la fille de son père.

es.L: Y uno comete abominación con la mujer de su prójimo, y otro contamina con infamia a su nuera, y otro en ti viola a su hermana, la hija de su padre.
es.B: Uno comete un acto detestable con la mujer de su prójimo; otro contamina vergonzosamente a su nuera; y otro en ti viola a su hermana, la hija de su propio padre.
es.R: Uno hace algo repugnante con la mujer de su prójimo. Otro tiene relaciones sexuales con su nuera y así la hace impura. Otro viola a su propia hermana, la hija de su padre.

decisions.choice: adultery, a daughter-in-law, a half-sister: the laws of Leviticus 18 and 20
decisions.reason: Leviticus forbids relations with a neighbor's wife (18:20; 20:10), with a daughter-in-law (18:15; 20:12) and with a sister, "your father's daughter" (18:9; 20:17). Ezekiel names each as done in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: abomination: an act the LORD finds detestable
decisions.reason: The same word is used for the sexual sins of Leviticus 18:26-30.

decisions.choice: plain and sober wording
decisions.reason: The register rule applies: the meaning is stated plainly, without crude or added detail. The book's wording for the word "abomination" is kept: "abomination" (L), "detestable act" (B), "disgusting thing" (R).

source.text: שֹׁ֥חַד לָֽקְחוּ־בָ֖ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ־דָּ֑ם נֶ֧שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּ֣ית לָקַ֗חַתְּ וַתְּבַצְּעִ֤י רֵעַ֨יִךְ֙ בַּעֹ֔שֶׁק וְאֹתִ֣י שָׁכַ֔חַתְּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A bribe they take in you in order to shed blood; interest and increase you take, and you make gain of your neighbors by extortion, and me you have forgotten, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: Bribes they take in you, in order to shed blood; interest and profit you take, and you make gain of your neighbors by oppression; and {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} you have forgotten, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: In you people take bribes to shed blood. You charge interest and take profit, you make gain from your neighbors by extortion, and you have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: People in you take money to have others killed. You charge interest and make a profit from loans. You cheat your neighbors to get rich. And you have forgotten {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: On prend chez toi des pots-de-vin pour répandre le sang ; tu prends un intérêt et une usure, et tu fais du profit sur ton prochain par l’oppression ; et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as oublié, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Chez toi, on accepte des pots-de-vin pour répandre le sang. Tu prêtes à intérêt et tu prends des bénéfices, tu t’enrichis aux dépens de ton prochain par l’extorsion, et tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as oublié, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Chez toi, des gens acceptent de l’argent pour faire tuer d’autres personnes. Tu fais payer des intérêts et tu fais du profit sur ce que tu prêtes. Tu voles ton prochain pour t’enrichir. Et tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as oublié, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Soborno han recibido en ti para derramar sangre; interés y usura has tomado, y has despojado a tus prójimos con violencia; y a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has olvidado, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: En ti se aceptan sobornos para derramar sangre. Cobras interés y usura, despojas a tus prójimos con extorsión, y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has olvidado a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: En ti hay quienes aceptan dinero para hacer matar a otros. Cobras intereses y sacas ganancias de los préstamos. Engañas a tus prójimos para enriquecerte. Y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} has olvidado, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

decisions.choice: bribes to shed blood
decisions.reason: The law curses anyone who "takes a bribe to strike down an innocent person" (Deuteronomy 27:25; compare Exodus 23:8).

decisions.choice: interest and profit: charging the poor for loans
decisions.reason: The law forbade charging interest or taking profit on a loan to a fellow Israelite in need (Exodus 22:24; Leviticus 25:36-37). Ezekiel 18:8, 13 and 17 count it among the marks of a wicked person.

decisions.choice: you have forgotten me: the root of the other sins
decisions.reason: Forgetting the LORD is the warning of Deuteronomy 8:11-14 and the charge of Jeremiah 2:32 and Hosea 13:6. The list of wrongs ends with the one that explains them all.

source.text: וְהִנֵּה֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי כַפִּ֔י אֶל־בִּצְעֵ֖ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית וְעַ֨ל־דָּמֵ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בְּתוֹכֵֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And behold, I strike my hand at your unjust gain that you have made, and at your blood that has been in your midst.

en.L: And see, I strike {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand at your unjust gain that you have made, and at your blood that has been in your midst.
en.B: Look, I strike {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands together at the dishonest gain you have made and at the bloodshed in your midst.
en.R: I clap {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands in anger at the money you have gained dishonestly and at the murders done in you.

fr.L: Et voici, je frappe {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main à cause du gain injuste que tu as fait, et à cause de ton sang qui a été au milieu de toi.
fr.B: Regarde, je frappe des mains à cause du gain malhonnête que tu as fait et du sang répandu au milieu de toi.
fr.R: Je frappe des mains avec colère à cause de l’argent que tu as gagné malhonnêtement et des meurtres commis chez toi.

es.L: Y mira, golpeo {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano por tu ganancia injusta que has obtenido, y por tu sangre que ha habido en medio de ti.
es.B: Mira, bato {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos contra la ganancia deshonesta que has obtenido y contra la sangre derramada en medio de ti.
es.R: Bato {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos con enojo por el dinero que has ganado con engaño y por los asesinatos cometidos en ti.

decisions.choice: strike my hand: a gesture of anger and scorn
decisions.reason: God makes the same gesture over the sword in 21:22, and the prophet in 6:11 and 21:19.

decisions.choice: in anger
decisions.reason: Readable says what the gesture means (m1).

source.text: הֲיַעֲמֹ֤ד לִבֵּךְ֙ אִם־תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדַ֔יִךְ לַיָּמִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Will endure your heart, or will be strong your hands, in the days that I [am] dealing with you? I, Yahweh, have spoken and will act.

en.L: Will your heart endure, or will your hands be strong, in the days when I am dealing with you? I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken, and I will act.
en.B: Will your courage hold, or your hands stay strong, in the days when I take action against you? I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken, and I will do it.
en.R: Will you still be brave? Will you be strong enough when I punish you? I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken, and I will do what I have said.

fr.L: Ton cœur tiendra-t-il bon, ou tes mains seront-elles fortes, aux jours où j’agirai contre toi ? Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé, et j’agirai.
fr.B: Ton courage tiendra-t-il, et tes mains resteront-elles fermes, aux jours où j’agirai contre toi ? Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé, et je le ferai.
fr.R: Seras-tu encore courageuse ? Seras-tu assez forte quand je te punirai ? C’est moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui le dis, et je ferai ce que j’ai dit.

es.L: ¿Resistirá tu corazón, o se mantendrán fuertes tus manos, en los días en que yo actúe contra ti? Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado, y lo haré.
es.B: ¿Seguirás teniendo valor, o se mantendrán fuertes tus manos, en los días en que yo actúe contra ti? Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado, y lo cumpliré.
es.R: ¿Seguirás siendo valiente? ¿Tendrás fuerzas cuando yo te castigue? Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lo he dicho, y haré lo que he dicho.

decisions.choice: will your heart endure, will your hands be strong?: will you have the courage and strength to bear it?
decisions.reason: The heart stands for courage and the hands for strength (compare 7:17; 21:12). The question expects the answer "no".

decisions.choice: I have spoken and I will act: God's word and his deed go together
decisions.reason: The same words close 17:24 and 36:36.

source.text: וַהֲפִיצוֹתִ֤י אוֹתָךְ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֖יךְ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וַהֲתִמֹּתִ֥י טֻמְאָתֵ֖ךְ מִמֵּֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you in the lands, and I will consume your uncleanness from you.

en.L: And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you in the lands, and I will consume your uncleanness out of you.
en.B: I will scatter you among the nations, spread you through the countries and burn away your uncleanness.
en.R: I will scatter you among the nations and spread you out through other countries. I will remove everything that makes you unclean.

fr.L: Et je te disperserai parmi les nations et je te disséminerai dans les pays, et je ferai disparaître de toi ton impureté.
fr.B: Je te disperserai parmi les nations, je te disséminerai dans les pays et je consumerai ton impureté.
fr.R: Je te disperserai parmi les nations et je t’éparpillerai dans d’autres pays. J’enlèverai tout ce qui te rend impure.

es.L: Y te esparciré entre las naciones y te dispersaré por las tierras, y consumiré de ti tu impureza.
es.B: Te esparciré entre las naciones, te dispersaré por los países y acabaré con tu impureza.
es.R: Te esparciré entre las naciones y te dispersaré por otros países. Quitaré todo lo que te hace impura.

decisions.choice: I will consume your uncleanness: the exile will put an end to it
decisions.reason: The verb means to finish or bring to an end. The scattering is punishment, but it also does away with the city's uncleanness, as the furnace of verses 17-22 pictures.

decisions.choice: scatter and disperse: the oath of the wilderness carried out
decisions.reason: The same words were used of God's oath in the wilderness (20:23).

source.text: וְנִחַ֥לְתְּ בָּ֖ךְ לְעֵינֵ֣י גוֹיִ֑ם וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And you will be profaned through yourself in [the] eyes of [the] nations, and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And you will be profaned through yourself in the eyes of the nations, and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Because of your own doing you will be dishonored before the nations. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: You will be disgraced in front of the nations because of what you have done. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et tu seras profanée par toi-même aux yeux des nations, et tu sauras que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Par ta propre faute, tu seras déshonorée devant les nations. Alors tu sauras que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Tu seras couverte de honte devant les nations à cause de ce que tu as fait. Alors tu sauras que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Y serás profanada por ti misma a los ojos de las naciones, y sabrás que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por tu propia culpa quedarás deshonrada ante las naciones. Entonces sabrás que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Quedarás avergonzada delante de las naciones por lo que has hecho. Entonces sabrás que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

decisions.choice: you will be profaned through yourself: the Hebrew text
alternatives: "I will take possession of you" (the Septuagint, reading a verb from the same letters)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew means that Jerusalem's own acts will bring her dishonor before the nations. The Greek seems to read the same letters as a different verb, "I will take you as an inheritance", and some read "I will be profaned", as God's name is profaned among the nations in 20:9 and 36:20. The Hebrew makes sense and is followed.

decisions.choice: you will know that I am the LORD: the book's refrain
decisions.reason: See the note at 6:7.

decisions.choice: sabrás (singular)
decisions.reason: The refrain is addressed here to the city as one, so it is singular 'sabrás', with the book's wording otherwise kept.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] word of Yahweh to me, saying:

en.L: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me, saying:
en.B: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me:
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave me this message:

fr.L: Et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée, disant :
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée :
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné ce message :

es.L: Vino a mí la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, diciendo:
es.B: La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a mí:
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio este mensaje:

decisions.choice: the formula as in Jeremiah
decisions.reason: A new message begins: the furnace (verses 18-22).

source.text: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הָיוּ־לִ֥י בֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְסִ֑יג כֻּלָּ֡ם נְ֠חֹשֶׁת וּבְדִ֨יל וּבַרְזֶ֤ל וְעוֹפֶ֨רֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר סִגִ֥ים כֶּ֖סֶף הָיֽוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, have become to me [the] house of Israel dross; all of them [are] bronze and tin and iron and lead in [the] midst of a furnace; dross of silver they have become.

en.L: Son of man, the house of Israel has become to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dross; all of them [are] bronze and tin and iron and lead in the middle of a furnace; they have become the dross of silver.
en.B: Son of man, in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight the house of Israel has become dross. All of them are bronze, tin, iron and lead left in the furnace; they have become the dross from silver.
en.R: Son of man, the people of Israel have become like worthless slag to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They are like the bronze, tin, iron and lead left in a furnace. They are only the waste left over when silver is refined.

fr.L: Fils d’homme, la maison d’Israël est devenue pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} des scories ; eux tous [sont] du bronze et de l’étain et du fer et du plomb au milieu d’une fournaise ; ils sont devenus des scories d’argent.
fr.B: Fils d’homme, à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux, la maison d’Israël est devenue des scories. Tous sont du bronze, de l’étain, du fer et du plomb restés dans la fournaise ; ils sont devenus les scories de l’argent.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, le peuple d’Israël est devenu comme des déchets sans valeur. Ils sont comme le bronze, l’étain, le fer et le plomb qui restent dans un four. Ils ne sont que les déchets qui restent quand on purifie l’argent.

es.L: Hijo de hombre, la casa de Israel se {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ha vuelto escoria; todos ellos [son] bronce y estaño y hierro y plomo en medio del horno; escoria de plata se han vuelto.
es.B: Hijo de hombre, ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos la casa de Israel se ha vuelto escoria. Todos ellos son bronce, estaño, hierro y plomo que quedan en el horno; se han vuelto la escoria de la plata.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} el pueblo de Israel se ha vuelto como escoria sin valor. Son como el bronce, el estaño, el hierro y el plomo que quedan en un horno. Son solo los desechos que quedan cuando se refina la plata.

decisions.choice: dross: the waste left when silver is refined
decisions.reason: Silver was refined by melting the ore with lead in a furnace; the other metals and impurities were drawn off as dross and the pure silver was left. Isaiah 1:22, 25 and Jeremiah 6:28-30 use the same picture for Israel.

decisions.choice: dross of silver: nothing of value is left
alternatives: a picture of purifying, which leaves pure silver at the end (Isaiah 1:25; Malachi 3:3)
decisions.reason: In Isaiah and Malachi the furnace refines and something precious remains. Here the people are all dross; the furnace of verses 19-22 is a picture of judgment, and no pure silver is mentioned.

decisions.choice: worthless slag; the waste left over when silver is refined
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word "dross" (m1).

decisions.choice: "scories" (L, B); "déchets sans valeur" (R)
decisions.reason: "Scories" as in French Isaiah 1:22; Readable says plainly what the waste of smelting is, as the English "worthless slag".

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֛עַן הֱי֥וֹת כֻּלְּכֶ֖ם לְסִגִ֑ים לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י קֹבֵ֣ץ אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֶל־תּ֖וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says [the] Lord Yahweh: Because all of you have become dross, therefore behold, I [am] gathering you into [the] midst of Jerusalem.

en.L: Therefore thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}: Because all of you have become dross, therefore see, I am gathering you into the midst of Jerusalem.
en.B: Therefore the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this: Because all of you have become dross, I am about to gather you into Jerusalem.
en.R: So this is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says: All of you have become like worthless slag. So I am going to gather you into Jerusalem.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Parce que vous êtes tous devenus des scories, à cause de cela, voici, je vous rassemble au milieu de Jérusalem.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Parce que vous êtes tous devenus des scories, je vais vous rassembler dans Jérusalem.
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} : Vous êtes tous devenus comme des déchets sans valeur. C’est pourquoi je vais vous rassembler dans Jérusalem.

es.L: Por tanto, así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto todos {{plural_you:ustedes se han vuelto|vosotros os habéis vuelto}} escoria, por tanto, {{plural_you:miren|mirad}}, yo {{plural_you:los|os}} reúno en medio de Jerusalén.
es.B: Por eso el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto: Por cuanto todos {{plural_you:ustedes se han vuelto|vosotros os habéis vuelto}} escoria, voy a {{plural_you:reunirlos|reuniros}} en Jerusalén.
es.R: Así que esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}: Todos {{plural_you:ustedes se han vuelto|vosotros os habéis vuelto}} como escoria sin valor. Por eso voy a {{plural_you:reunirlos|reuniros}} en Jerusalén.

decisions.choice: gathered into Jerusalem: the people crowd into the city as the enemy comes
decisions.reason: When an army invaded, people from the countryside fled into the walled city (Jeremiah 4:5; 35:11). The city they trusted to protect them becomes the furnace.

decisions.choice: plural 'you' from here to verse 22, with plural_you spans
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the city (feminine singular) to the people of Israel in the plural, and Spanish follows.

source.text: קְבֻ֣צַת כֶּ֡סֶף וּ֠נְחֹשֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֨ל וְעוֹפֶ֤רֶת וּבְדִיל֙ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר לָפַֽחַת־עָלָ֥יו אֵ֖שׁ לְהַנְתִּ֑יךְ כֵּ֤ן אֶקְבֹּץ֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י וּבַחֲמָתִ֔י וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י וְהִתַּכְתִּ֖י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [As] a gathering of silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin into [the] middle of a furnace, to blow on it fire to melt [it], so I will gather in my anger and in my wrath, and I will put [you in] and melt you.

en.L: As [one] gathers silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin into the middle of a furnace, to blow fire upon it for melting, so in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath I will gather [you], and I will put [you in] and melt you.
en.B: As silver, bronze, iron, lead and tin are gathered into a furnace and fire is blown on them to melt them, so I will gather you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath, put you in and melt you.
en.R: People put silver, bronze, iron, lead and tin into a furnace. They blow on the fire to make it hot enough to melt the metals. In the same way I will gather you in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} great anger. I will put you into the fire and melt you.

fr.L: Comme [on] rassemble l’argent et le bronze et le fer et le plomb et l’étain au milieu d’une fournaise, pour souffler le feu sur eux afin de [les] fondre, ainsi dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur je [vous] rassemblerai, et je [vous y] mettrai et je vous fondrai.
fr.B: Comme on rassemble l’argent, le bronze, le fer, le plomb et l’étain dans une fournaise et qu’on souffle sur le feu pour les fondre, ainsi je vous rassemblerai dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère et dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur, je vous y mettrai et je vous fondrai.
fr.R: On met de l’argent, du bronze, du fer, du plomb et de l’étain dans un four. On souffle sur le feu pour qu’il soit assez chaud pour fondre les métaux. De la même manière, je vous rassemblerai dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} grande colère. Je vous mettrai dans le feu et je vous fondrai.

es.L: Como se reúne la plata y el bronce y el hierro y el plomo y el estaño en medio del horno, para soplar sobre ello el fuego para fundir[lo], así [{{plural_you:los|os}}] reuniré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, y [{{plural_you:los|os}}] pondré [allí] y {{plural_you:los|os}} fundiré.
es.B: Como se reúnen la plata, el bronce, el hierro, el plomo y el estaño en un horno, y se sopla el fuego sobre ellos para fundirlos, así {{plural_you:los|os}} reuniré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira y en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, {{plural_you:los|os}} meteré allí y {{plural_you:los|os}} fundiré.
es.R: La gente echa plata, bronce, hierro, plomo y estaño en un horno. Soplan el fuego para que se caliente lo suficiente y funda los metales. De la misma manera {{plural_you:los|os}} reuniré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} gran enojo. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} echaré al fuego y {{plural_you:los|os}} fundiré.

decisions.choice: blowing on the fire: with bellows, to make the furnace hot
decisions.reason: A smith blew air into the fire with bellows to raise the heat (Jeremiah 6:29). In verse 21 God himself blows with the fire of his wrath.

decisions.choice: I will put you in: or "I will leave you there"
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to set down or to leave. Here it most likely means placing the metal in the furnace.

source.text: וְכִנַּסְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְנָפַחְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּאֵ֣שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֑י וְנִתַּכְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will gather you and blow on you with [the] fire of my wrath, and you will be melted in its midst.

en.L: And I will gather you, and I will blow on you with the fire of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath; and in its midst you will melt.
en.B: I will gather you and blow the fire of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on you, and you will melt inside the city.
en.R: I will gather you and blow on you with {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fiery anger, and you will melt inside the city.

fr.L: Et je vous rassemblerai et je soufflerai sur vous le feu de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur ; et au milieu d’elle vous fondrez.
fr.B: Je vous rassemblerai et je soufflerai sur vous le feu de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur, et vous fondrez à l’intérieur de la ville.
fr.R: Je vous rassemblerai et je soufflerai sur vous le feu de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, et vous fondrez à l’intérieur de la ville.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:los|os}} reuniré y soplaré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} con el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, y {{plural_you:serán fundidos|seréis fundidos}} en medio de ella.
es.B: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} reuniré y soplaré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor, y {{plural_you:se fundirán|os fundiréis}} dentro de la ciudad.
es.R: {{plural_you:Los|Os}} reuniré y soplaré sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo, y {{plural_you:se fundirán|os fundiréis}} dentro de la ciudad.

decisions.choice: in its midst: inside Jerusalem, which is the furnace
decisions.reason: "Its" is feminine and refers back to Jerusalem (verse 19), the place of the melting.

decisions.choice: inside the city
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the city (m1).

source.text: כְּהִתּ֥וּךְ כֶּ֨סֶף֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר כֵּ֖ן תֻּתְּכ֣וּ בְתוֹכָ֑הּ וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שָׁפַ֥כְתִּי חֲמָתִ֖י עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: As silver is melted in [the] midst of a furnace, so you will be melted in its midst; and you will know that I, Yahweh, have poured out my wrath on you.

en.L: As silver is melted in the middle of a furnace, so you will be melted in its midst; and you will know that I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have poured out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on you.
en.B: As silver melts in a furnace, so you will melt inside the city. Then you will know that it is I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who have poured out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath on you.
en.R: Just as silver melts in a furnace, you will melt inside the city. Then you will know that it is I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who have poured out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger on you.

fr.L: Comme l’argent est fondu au milieu d’une fournaise, ainsi vous serez fondus au milieu d’elle ; et vous saurez que moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai répandu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur sur vous.
fr.B: Comme l’argent fond dans la fournaise, ainsi vous fondrez à l’intérieur de la ville. Alors vous saurez que c’est moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ai répandu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur sur vous.
fr.R: Comme l’argent fond dans un four, vous fondrez à l’intérieur de la ville. Alors vous saurez que c’est moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui ai répandu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère sur vous.

es.L: Como se funde la plata en medio del horno, así {{plural_you:serán fundidos|seréis fundidos}} en medio de ella; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he derramado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Como la plata se funde en un horno, así {{plural_you:se fundirán|os fundiréis}} dentro de la ciudad. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he derramado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Así como la plata se funde en un horno, {{plural_you:ustedes se fundirán|vosotros os fundiréis}} dentro de la ciudad. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he derramado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

decisions.choice: you will know that I, the LORD, have poured out my wrath: the refrain, extended
decisions.reason: The refrain "you will know that I am the LORD" here says what they will know: that the disaster is the LORD's own judgment.

source.text: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] word of Yahweh to me, saying:

en.L: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me, saying:
en.B: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me:
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave me this message:

fr.L: Et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée, disant :
fr.B: La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} me fut adressée :
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a donné ce message :

es.L: Vino a mí la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, diciendo:
es.B: La palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino a mí:
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dio este mensaje:

decisions.choice: the formula as in Jeremiah
decisions.reason: A new message begins: every group in the land has failed (verses 24-31).

source.text: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם אֱמָר־לָ֕הּ אַ֣תְּ אֶ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א מְטֹהָרָ֖ה הִ֑יא לֹ֥א גֻשְׁמָ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם זָֽעַם׃

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, say to her, You [are] a land not cleansed, not rained upon in [the] day of indignation.

en.L: Son of man, say to her, You [are] a land that is not cleansed, not rained upon in the day of indignation.
en.B: Son of man, say to the land, You are a land that has not been cleansed, that has had no rain on the day of wrath.
en.R: Son of man, speak to the land of Israel. Tell it, You are a land that has not been made clean. No rain has fallen on you on the day of anger.

fr.L: Fils d’homme, dis-lui : Tu [es] une terre qui n’est pas purifiée, qui n’a pas reçu de pluie au jour de l’indignation.
fr.B: Fils d’homme, dis au pays : Tu es une terre qui n’a pas été purifiée, qui n’a pas reçu de pluie au jour de la colère.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, parle au pays d’Israël. Dis-lui : Tu es une terre qui n’a pas été rendue pure. Aucune pluie n’est tombée sur toi au jour de la colère.

es.L: Hijo de hombre, dile: Tú [eres] una tierra no purificada, no regada por la lluvia en el día de la indignación.
es.B: Hijo de hombre, dile a la tierra: Tú eres una tierra que no ha sido purificada, que no ha recibido lluvia en el día de la ira.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, habla a la tierra de Israel. Dile: Eres una tierra que no ha sido purificada. No ha caído lluvia sobre ti en el día del enojo.

decisions.choice: not cleansed: the Hebrew text
alternatives: "not rained upon" (the Septuagint, which has the same word in both halves of the verse)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "not cleansed" and then "not rained upon"; the Greek has "not rained upon" in the first half too. The Hebrew pairs the two pictures: a land that has not been washed clean and has had no rain.

decisions.choice: no rain on the day of wrath: rain withheld as a sign of judgment
decisions.reason: Rain was a sign of God's blessing, and drought of his anger (Deuteronomy 11:13-17; Jeremiah 3:3; Amos 4:7). The land is both unwashed and unblessed.

decisions.choice: the land; the land of Israel
decisions.reason: "Her" in Hebrew is the land, as the rest of the verse shows; Balanced and Readable name it.

source.text: קֶ֤שֶׁר נְבִיאֶ֨יהָ֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ כַּאֲרִ֥י שׁוֹאֵ֖ג טֹ֣רֵֽף טָ֑רֶף נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָכָ֗לוּ חֹ֤סֶן וִיקָר֙ יִקָּ֔חוּ אַלְמְנוֹתֶ֖יהָ הִרְבּ֥וּ בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A conspiracy of her prophets in her midst, like a lion roaring, tearing prey; lives they have devoured; treasure and precious things they take; her widows they have made many in her midst.

en.L: [There is] a conspiracy of her prophets in her midst, like a roaring lion tearing prey; they have devoured lives; treasure and precious things they take; her widows they have multiplied in her midst.
en.B: Her prophets within her have joined in a conspiracy. Like a roaring lion tearing its prey, they devour people; they seize treasure and precious things and make many widows in the land.
en.R: Her prophets have joined together in an evil plan. They are like a roaring lion tearing its prey. They destroy people's lives. They take treasure and valuable things. Because of them, many women in the land have become widows.

fr.L: [Il y a] une conspiration de ses prophètes au milieu d’elle, comme un lion rugissant qui déchire la proie ; ils ont dévoré des vies ; ils prennent les trésors et les choses précieuses ; ils ont multiplié ses veuves au milieu d’elle.
fr.B: Ses prophètes, au milieu d’elle, se sont unis dans une conspiration. Comme un lion rugissant qui déchire sa proie, ils dévorent les gens ; ils s’emparent des trésors et des objets précieux et font beaucoup de veuves dans le pays.
fr.R: Ses prophètes se sont unis pour faire un plan mauvais. Ils sont comme un lion qui rugit en déchirant sa proie. Ils détruisent la vie des gens. Ils prennent les trésors et les objets de valeur. À cause d’eux, beaucoup de femmes du pays sont devenues veuves.

es.L: Conspiración de sus profetas [hay] en medio de ella, como león rugiente que desgarra la presa; han devorado vidas; tesoros y cosas preciosas toman; sus viudas han multiplicado en medio de ella.
es.B: Sus profetas se han conjurado dentro de ella. Como león rugiente que desgarra su presa, devoran a la gente; se apoderan de tesoros y cosas preciosas, y multiplican las viudas en el país.
es.R: Sus profetas se han unido en un plan malvado. Son como un león que ruge mientras desgarra su presa. Destruyen la vida de la gente. Se llevan tesoros y cosas de valor. Por su culpa, muchas mujeres del país se han quedado viudas.

decisions.choice: a conspiracy of her prophets: the Hebrew text
alternatives: "whose princes in her midst are like a roaring lion" (the Septuagint, reading "her princes" for the very similar "her prophets")
decisions.reason: In Hebrew "her prophets" and "her princes" differ by one letter, and "conspiracy" and "who" are also close. The Greek reads "princes", which would fit the killing, plunder and widows of this verse and keep the prophets for verse 28. The Hebrew is followed, and it makes sense: prophets who took sides in the plots of the city (13:19; Jeremiah 23:9-14).

decisions.choice: like a roaring lion: Ezekiel's list follows Zephaniah 3:3-4
decisions.reason: Zephaniah describes Jerusalem's officials as roaring lions, its judges as wolves, its prophets as reckless and its priests as profaning what is holy and doing violence to the instruction. Ezekiel 22:25-28 takes up the same list, adding the people of the land (verse 29).

decisions.choice: in the land
decisions.reason: "Her" here is the land (verse 24). Readable says that the widows are the wives of those killed.

source.text: כֹּהֲנֶ֜יהָ חָמְס֣וּ תוֹרָתִי֮ וַיְחַלְּל֣וּ קָדָשַׁי֒ בֵּֽין־קֹ֤דֶשׁ לְחֹל֙ לֹ֣א הִבְדִּ֔ילוּ וּבֵין־הַטָּמֵ֥א לְטָה֖וֹר לֹ֣א הוֹדִ֑יעוּ וּמִשַׁבְּתוֹתַי֙ הֶעְלִ֣ימוּ עֵֽינֵיהֶ֔ם וָאֵחַ֖ל בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Her priests have done violence to my instruction and profaned my holy things; between holy and common they have not distinguished, and between the unclean and the clean they have not taught; and from my sabbaths they have hidden their eyes, and I am profaned in their midst.

en.L: Her priests have done violence to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} instruction and profaned {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy things; between holy and common they have made no distinction, and between the unclean and the clean they have not taught [the difference]; and from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths they have hidden their eyes, and I am profaned among them.
en.B: Her priests do violence to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} instruction and profane {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy things. They do not separate the holy from the common, and do not teach the difference between the unclean and the clean. They shut their eyes to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbaths, and so I am dishonored among them.
en.R: Her priests twist {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} teaching and treat {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy things as common. They do not teach people the difference between what is holy and what is not, or between what is unclean and what is clean. They pay no attention to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Sabbath days. So among them I am treated with no respect.

fr.L: Ses prêtres ont fait violence à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} loi et ont profané {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} choses saintes ; entre le saint et le profane ils n’ont pas fait de distinction, et entre l’impur et le pur ils n’ont pas enseigné [la différence] ; et devant {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats ils ont fermé les yeux, et je suis profané au milieu d’eux.
fr.B: Ses prêtres font violence à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} instruction et profanent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} choses saintes. Ils ne séparent pas le saint du profane et n’enseignent pas la différence entre l’impur et le pur. Ils ferment les yeux sur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} sabbats, et ainsi je suis déshonoré au milieu d’eux.
fr.R: Ses prêtres tordent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} enseignement et traitent {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} choses saintes comme des choses ordinaires. Ils n’apprennent pas aux gens la différence entre ce qui est saint et ce qui ne l’est pas, ni entre ce qui est impur et ce qui est pur. Ils ne font aucune attention à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jours de sabbat. Ainsi, au milieu d’eux, on ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} respecte pas.

es.L: Sus sacerdotes han violentado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} instrucción y han profanado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} cosas santas; entre lo santo y lo profano no han hecho diferencia, y entre lo impuro y lo puro no han enseñado [la diferencia]; y de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados han apartado sus ojos, y yo soy profanado en medio de ellos.
es.B: Sus sacerdotes violentan {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} instrucción y profanan {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} cosas santas. No separan lo santo de lo profano, ni enseñan la diferencia entre lo impuro y lo puro. Cierran los ojos ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados, y así soy deshonrado entre ellos.
es.R: Sus sacerdotes tuercen {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enseñanza y tratan {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} cosas santas como si fueran comunes. No enseñan a la gente la diferencia entre lo que es santo y lo que no lo es, ni entre lo impuro y lo puro. No hacen caso de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sábados. Así que entre ellos no se {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} respeta.

decisions.choice: holy and common, unclean and clean: the priests' own task, as Leviticus 10:10-11 sets it
decisions.reason: The priests were given the duty "to separate between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean, and to teach" the people (Leviticus 10:10-11). Ezekiel's future priests will do it (44:23). Zephaniah 3:4 also charges the priests with doing violence to the instruction.

decisions.choice: hidden their eyes from my Sabbaths: ignored them
decisions.reason: To hide one's eyes is to refuse to see (Leviticus 20:4; Isaiah 1:15).

decisions.choice: instruction (L, B); teaching (R)
decisions.reason: The word *torah* follows the wording settled for the prophets. The phrase "do violence to the instruction" keeps the wording of Zephaniah 3:4 at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: God's *torah* "loi" (L), "instruction" (B), "enseignement" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled French wording for God's *torah* in the prophets; the capital is kept for the Law of Moses.

decisions.choice: instrucción (L, B); enseñanza (R)
decisions.reason: Torah is worded as in Spanish Isaiah and Psalms; the pairs 'santo / profano' and 'impuro / puro' follow Leviticus 10:10.

source.text: שָׂרֶ֣יהָ בְקִרְבָּ֔הּ כִּזְאֵבִ֖ים טֹ֣רְפֵי טָ֑רֶף לִשְׁפָּךְ־דָּם֙ לְאַבֵּ֣ד נְפָשׁ֔וֹת לְמַ֖עַן בְּצֹ֥עַ בָּֽצַע׃

records.literal_gloss: Her officials in her midst [are] like wolves tearing prey, to shed blood, to destroy lives, in order to make unjust gain.

en.L: Her officials in her midst [are] like wolves tearing prey, shedding blood, destroying lives, to make unjust gain.
en.B: Her officials within her are like wolves tearing their prey. They shed blood and destroy lives to make dishonest gain.
en.R: Her leaders are like wolves tearing their prey. They kill people and destroy lives to get rich by cheating.

fr.L: Ses chefs au milieu d’elle [sont] comme des loups qui déchirent la proie, répandant le sang, faisant périr des vies, pour faire un gain injuste.
fr.B: Ses chefs, au milieu d’elle, sont comme des loups qui déchirent leur proie. Ils répandent le sang et font périr des vies pour s’enrichir malhonnêtement.
fr.R: Ses dirigeants sont comme des loups qui déchirent leur proie. Ils tuent des gens et détruisent des vies pour s’enrichir en trichant.

es.L: Sus príncipes en medio de ella [son] como lobos que desgarran la presa, derramando sangre, destruyendo vidas, para obtener ganancia injusta.
es.B: Sus jefes dentro de ella son como lobos que desgarran su presa. Derraman sangre y destruyen vidas para obtener ganancias deshonestas.
es.R: Sus dirigentes son como lobos que desgarran su presa. Matan a la gente y destruyen vidas para enriquecerse con engaños.

decisions.choice: officials like wolves: as Zephaniah 3:3
decisions.reason: Zephaniah calls the judges "wolves of the evening" and the officials "roaring lions". Ezekiel uses the lion for verse 25 and the wolf for the officials.

decisions.choice: officials (L, B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The word *sar* follows the wording settled for the prophets.

decisions.choice: *sarim* "chefs" (L, B), "dirigeants" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled French wording for *sarim*, kept apart from "princes" for the *nesi'im* of verse 6.

decisions.choice: príncipes (L); jefes (B); dirigentes (R)
decisions.reason: Human officials (sarim) keep the wording of Spanish Jeremiah at each level; the term sheet marks it for review.

source.text: וּנְבִיאֶ֗יהָ טָח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ תָּפֵ֔ל חֹזִ֣ים שָׁ֔וְא וְקֹסְמִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב אֹמְרִ֗ים כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דִבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And her prophets have smeared for them whitewash, seeing false [visions] and divining for them a lie, saying, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh, and Yahweh has not spoken.

en.L: And her prophets have smeared whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, "Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}," when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken.
en.B: Her prophets cover these deeds with whitewash. They see false visions and practice lying divination for them, saying, "The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this," when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken.
en.R: Her prophets cover up these sins, as people cover a bad wall with whitewash. They see false visions and tell lies about the future. They say, "This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says," but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not spoken at all.

fr.L: Et ses prophètes ont enduit de chaux pour eux, voyant des visions fausses et pratiquant pour eux la divination de mensonge, disant : « Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} », alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas parlé.
fr.B: Ses prophètes recouvrent ces actes d’une couche de chaux. Ils ont des visions fausses et pratiquent pour eux une divination mensongère, en disant : « Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci », alors que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas parlé.
fr.R: Ses prophètes cachent ces péchés, comme on cache un mauvais mur sous une couche de chaux. Ils ont des visions fausses et disent des mensonges sur l’avenir. Ils disent : « Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} », mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas parlé du tout.

es.L: Y sus profetas les han recubierto con cal, viendo visiones falsas y adivinándoles mentira, diciendo: «Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}», cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha hablado.
es.B: Sus profetas cubren estas obras con cal. Ven visiones falsas y les dan adivinaciones mentirosas, diciendo: «El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto», cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha hablado.
es.R: Sus profetas encubren estos pecados, como quien cubre con cal una pared en mal estado. Ven visiones falsas y dicen mentiras sobre el futuro. Dicen: «Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}», pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no ha dicho nada.

decisions.choice: smeared whitewash: the picture of 13:10-16
decisions.reason: In chapter 13 the false prophets cover a flimsy wall with whitewash, giving it a look of strength, and God's storm brings it down. Here the whitewash covers the crimes of the leaders.

decisions.choice: false visions, lying divination, "Thus says the Lord GOD": as 13:6-9
decisions.reason: Ezekiel uses the same words for the prophets who speak in God's name without being sent (13:6-7; Jeremiah 23:16-32).

decisions.choice: cover up these sins, as people cover a bad wall with whitewash
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m1). The prophets' words take quotation marks, since they are speech quoted inside the oracle.

source.text: עַ֤ם הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ עָ֣שְׁקוּ עֹ֔שֶׁק וְגָזְל֖וּ גָּזֵ֑ל וְעָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנ֔וּ וְאֶת־הַגֵּ֥ר עָשְׁק֖וּ בְּלֹ֥א מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery; and [the] poor and needy they have wronged; and the sojourner they have oppressed without justice.

en.L: The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery; and they have wronged the poor and needy, and they have oppressed the sojourner without justice.
en.B: The people of the land practice extortion and commit robbery. They wrong the poor and needy and oppress the foreigner, denying them justice.
en.R: Even the landowners cheat others and rob them. They mistreat poor and needy people. They oppress foreigners and do not treat them fairly.

fr.L: Le peuple du pays a pratiqué l’extorsion et commis le vol ; et ils ont maltraité le pauvre et l’indigent, et ils ont opprimé l’étranger sans justice.
fr.B: Le peuple du pays pratique l’extorsion et commet des vols. On maltraite le pauvre et l’indigent, et on opprime l’étranger en lui refusant justice.
fr.R: Même les propriétaires du pays trompent les autres et les volent. Ils maltraitent les pauvres et les malheureux. Ils oppriment les étrangers et ne les traitent pas avec justice.

es.L: El pueblo de la tierra ha practicado la extorsión y ha cometido robo; y han maltratado al pobre y al necesitado, y al forastero han oprimido sin justicia.
es.B: La gente del país practica la extorsión y comete robos. Maltratan al pobre y al necesitado, y oprimen al extranjero negándole la justicia.
es.R: Hasta los dueños de tierras engañan a los demás y les roban. Maltratan a los pobres y a los necesitados. Oprimen a los extranjeros y no los tratan con justicia.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the landowning citizens of Judah
alternatives: the common people as a whole
decisions.reason: In the last years of Judah, "the people of the land" were the free, landowning men who had a voice in public affairs, such as making a king (2 Kings 21:24; 23:30). Ezekiel names them after the rulers, priests, officials and prophets: no group is innocent.

decisions.choice: the poor, the needy and the sojourner: those the law protects
decisions.reason: See verse 7 and Exodus 22:20-26; Deuteronomy 24:14-15.

decisions.choice: the landowners
decisions.reason: Readable says who the people of the land were (m1), and adds "even", since they are the last group in the list.

source.text: וָאֲבַקֵּ֣שׁ מֵהֶ֡ם אִ֣ישׁ גֹּֽדֵר־גָּדֵר֩ וְעֹמֵ֨ד בַּפֶּ֧רֶץ לְפָנַ֛י בְּעַ֥ד הָאָ֖רֶץ לְבִלְתִּ֣י שַׁחֲתָ֑הּ וְלֹ֖א מָצָֽאתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I sought among them a man building up a wall and standing in the breach before me on behalf of the land, so as not to destroy it; but I did not find [one].

en.L: And I sought among them {{gender:someone|a man}} who would build up a wall and stand in the breach before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} on behalf of the land, so that I would not destroy it; but I did not find [one].
en.B: I looked for {{gender:someone|a man}} among them who would repair the wall and stand before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in the gap on behalf of the land, so that I would not destroy it, but I found no one.
en.R: I looked for {{gender:someone|a man}} among them to build up the wall and to stand before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in the broken place to protect the land, so that I would not destroy it. But I could not find anyone.

fr.L: Et j’ai cherché parmi eux {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} qui relève le mur et qui se tienne sur la brèche devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} en faveur du pays, pour que je ne le détruise pas ; mais je n’[en] ai pas trouvé.
fr.B: J’ai cherché parmi eux {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} qui répare le mur et qui se tienne devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} sur la brèche en faveur du pays, pour que je ne le détruise pas, mais je n’ai trouvé personne.
fr.R: J’ai cherché parmi eux {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} qui reconstruise le mur et qui se tienne devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} dans l’endroit cassé pour protéger le pays, afin que je ne le détruise pas. Mais je n’ai trouvé personne.

es.L: Y busqué entre ellos {{gender:alguien|un hombre}} que levantara un muro y se pusiera en la brecha delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a favor de la tierra, para que yo no la destruyera; pero no [lo] hallé.
es.B: Busqué entre ellos {{gender:a alguien|a un hombre}} que reparara el muro y se pusiera delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la brecha a favor de la tierra, para que yo no la destruyera, pero no hallé a nadie.
es.R: Busqué entre ellos {{gender:a alguien|a un hombre}} que levantara el muro y se pusiera delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} en la parte rota para proteger la tierra, para que yo no la destruyera. Pero no encontré a nadie.

decisions.choice: build up a wall and stand in the breach: defend the city, here by turning God's anger away
decisions.reason: When an enemy broke through a wall, soldiers stood in the gap to hold it. In 13:5 the false prophets did not "go up into the breaches" or build up a wall. Psalm 106:23 says that Moses "stood in the breach before" God to turn away his wrath; that is the kind of person God looked for: someone whose righteousness and pleading would stand between the land and judgment.

decisions.choice: I found no one: as Jeremiah 5:1
decisions.reason: In Jeremiah 5:1 God tells the prophet to search Jerusalem for one person who does justice, so that he might pardon the city.

decisions.choice: {{gender:someone|a man}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word "man" here means any person, so every level has "someone" with "a man" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:quelqu'un|un homme}}" at every level
decisions.reason: As the English {{gender:someone|a man}}: anyone, man or woman, could have stood in the breach; the traditional "un homme" is the alternative.

decisions.choice: {{gender:alguien|un hombre}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'a man' means any person here; Spanish has both wordings, so the setting gives the traditional one.

source.text: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ זַעְמִ֔י בְּאֵ֥שׁ עֶבְרָתִ֖י כִּלִּיתִ֑ים דַּרְכָּם֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֣ם נָתַ֔תִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I have poured out on them my indignation; with [the] fire of my wrath I have consumed them; their way on their heads I have brought, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: So I have poured out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} indignation on them; with the fire of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath I have consumed them; I have brought their way on their heads, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: So I have poured out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} indignation on them; I have finished them off with the fire of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath and brought their conduct down on their own heads, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: So I have poured out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger on them. I have destroyed them with the fire of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} fury. I have punished them for what they have done, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Alors j’ai répandu sur eux {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} indignation ; par le feu de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur je les ai consumés ; j’ai fait retomber leur conduite sur leur tête, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Alors j’ai répandu sur eux {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} indignation ; je les ai achevés par le feu de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur et j’ai fait retomber leur conduite sur leur propre tête, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Alors j’ai répandu {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère sur eux. Je les ai détruits par le feu de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur. Je les ai punis pour ce qu’ils ont fait, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

es.L: Por tanto, he derramado sobre ellos {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} indignación; con el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor los he consumido; su camino he hecho recaer sobre su cabeza, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por eso he derramado sobre ellos {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} indignación; con el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} furor he acabado con ellos y he hecho recaer su conducta sobre su propia cabeza, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Por eso he derramado sobre ellos {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} indignación. Los he destruido con el fuego de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo. Los he castigado por lo que han hecho, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

decisions.choice: I have poured out: spoken as already done
decisions.reason: The verbs are past forms, but Jerusalem has not yet fallen. As often in the prophets, a coming judgment is spoken of as already done, because it is certain.

decisions.choice: I have brought their way on their heads: they bear the result of their own conduct
decisions.reason: The same words are used in 9:10, 11:21 and 16:43.

decisions.choice: I have punished them for what they have done
alternatives: I have brought their way on their heads
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m2).
